items.verse: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
items.verseEn: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
And We guided them on the straight path.

items.verse: ثَانِىَ عِطْفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌۭ ۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
items.verseEn: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allāh. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَـٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
items.verseEn: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.

items.verse: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا
items.verseEn: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.

categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ مُوسَىٰ وَالْخَضِرِ فِي سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ
categories.nameEn: Key Terms from the Story of Musa and Al-Khidr in Surah Al-Kahf

items.verse: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَٱرْتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًۭا
items.verseEn: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.

items.verse: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
items.verseEn: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.

items.verse: قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَنِى فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِى عَن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًۭا
items.verseEn: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention [i.e., explanation]."

items.verse: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا
items.verseEn: [Al-Khiḍr] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"

categories.name: مَا لَا يُغْنِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
categories.nameEn: Things that will not avail on the Day of Judgment

items.verse: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًۭا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا شَفَـٰعَةٌۭ وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
items.verseEn: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.

items.verse: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
items.verseEn: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

items.verse: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
items.verseEn: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

items.verse: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
items.verseEn: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.

harf.hint: Unlawful - what the disbelievers falsely declared of Allah's provisions, the opposite of permitted
harf.arabicVerse: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ فَجَعَلْتُم مِّنْهُ حَرَامًۭا وَحَلَـٰلًۭا قُلْ ءَآللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ ۖ أَمْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ
harf.verse: 10:59 - Say, "Have you seen what Allāh has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" Say, "Has Allāh permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about Allāh?"

deduction.title: The Voice in the Ancient Sands
deduction.intro: Among the earliest messengers of Allah, there was one whose name shines briefly yet meaningfully in the Quran. This individual lived long before many great prophets were sent, and was known for unwavering truthfulness and patience. Their story is brief but their legacy endures in the eternal record. Who is this noble soul?
clues: I am one of the earliest messengers, mentioned briefly yet meaningfully in the Quran.
My character was defined by an unwavering commitment to truth.
I am remembered in the book of Allah among those who were steadfast and patient.
Only a few short verses in the Quran tell my story.
Allah honored me in a way that is uniquely mine, not shared with other prophets.
I was raised to a high station, a singular honor in the Quran.

trial.label: Defining Moment
options: I was raised to a high station by Allah
I built a great ark to save my people
I challenged the sorcerers of Pharaoh
I was thrown into a pit by my brothers
I lost my eyesight from sorrow over my son
trial.answer: I was raised to a high station by Allah

outcome.label: Divine Honor
options: A high station unlike any other
Dominion over jinn and the winds
An heir from my old age
outcome.answer: A high station unlike any other

deduction.arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
deduction.verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)

scramble.hint: A powerful reminder from Surah Al-Inshiqaq about the human journey and the inevitable meeting with our Lord — a call to self-accountability and purposeful striving.
scramble.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
scramble.verseEn: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.

root.meaning: This root centers on the idea of error or going astray, from a small slip to a deliberate sin. Related words simply shade this same meaning, adding ideas like the doer, the act, or fault itself.
